title: Brock and Grey
description: About Us The ‘reorganizational exit' Brock and Grey is a leading strategic buy-side and sell-side representative for a unique network of special situations and distressed investors. Our sponsors don’t do “business as usual.” Instead, they invest in current owner-operators with meaningful seller incentives through their acquisitions. These incentives translate into truly successful exits and meaningful sell-side engagements, where otherwise not possible. Our buy-side sponsors invest differently – maximizing value for sellers and sell-side intermediaries in underperforming or distressed business sales. Historically, special situations and distress have been a buyer’s market, with purchasers inheriting the majority of value in a transaction. Thus, in the context of underperformance, sell-side engagements have been marginal at best. More sell-side value. Brock and Grey, working in strategic alliance with sell-side intermediaries, is fundamentally re-balancing this value exchange. It starts with our sponsors’ very different investment strategy, which results in far more value for sellers and their sell-side intermediaries. By definition, an investment in distress is an investment in the resolution of liabilities and in the relaunch of the business, in order to capture underlying enterprise value. The historic problem for sellers (and sell-side intermediaries) is that this process has traditionally been investor-led, leaving sellers on the sidelines and only marginal opportunities for sell-side intermediaries. Investing in sellers, not just assets. Our network’s unique approach invests heavily in current owner-operators, not just their assets, resulting in truly successful exits and meaningful sell-side engagements. Rather than being incentivized by simply inheriting assets at the lowest possible cost, our sponsors invest in the skill-sets of sellers and key employees, staking them in the restructuring and relaunch of underlying business value.  As an investment strategy,

description: Description Description : 5795 Kilbannan Court Dublin, OH 43017 Nestled on a beautifully landscaped corner lot in Dublin's prestigious Muirfield community, this well-maintained home offers over 3,500± square feet of comfortable living space. The inviting family room features a cozy gas log fireplace and wood-beamed ceiling, opening to a vaulted three-season room—perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or relaxing year round. The spacious kitchen includes granite counter tops and an island, while two versatile first-floor flex rooms provide ideal space for a home office, exercise room, or additional bedroom. Upstairs, the owner's suite is accompanied by three generously sized bedrooms and a bathroom featuring a luxurious Sanijet hydrotherapy tub. The finished lower level offers additional recreation or entertainment space along with abundant storage. Outside, enjoy a private backyard retreat with multi-level paver patios, a fire pit, water feature, hot tub that conveys, an irrigation system, and plenty of green space for family gatherings and outdoor enjoyment. Located just steps from the Muirfield Tournament gate and close to community pools, tennis courts, parks, and walking trails, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and the exceptional Muirfield lifestyle. title: Harcourts Desert Homes
description:
About us Harcourts Desert Homes is a locally owned international real estate brokerage based in Palm Springs, CA. Founded in 1888, Harcourts International is the the #6 real estate company in the world.  Harcourts technology platform was recently named  "Best-in-Class" for mobile technology in real estate. 
Our company and agents have been dubbed "Agents of Change".  This award was significant as Harcourts beat out the entire global competition.

Harcourts Desert Homes leverages this revolutionary technology to market and sell residential and commercial properties faster than any other brokerage worldwide.  In additional to selling real estate in the traditional manner, Harcourts Auctions is a pioneer in selling NON-REO and NON-distressed properties for top dollar via our auction platform.  A non-traditional real estate platform in use for more than 100+ years.  There is no other international brokerage utilizing both traditional and non-traditional selling tools to expedite real estate sells for top dollar for their client base. 

The ownership of Harcourts Desert Homes is top-producing seasoned real estate team, Scott Palermo, Managing Broker and Jim Sanak , REALTOR,\.  This award winning team has over 30+ years combined real estate experience in the Coachella Valley and West Los Angeles markets.

 Remember in Real Estate, "Knowledge is Power!"  

Contact Scott Palermo or Jim Sanak at Harcourts Desert Homes for help with your property needs or to join our team! title: You Built a Successful Business. We can Help you Sell It.
description: Inquire Now Support during the process The decision to sell your business is a serious one, and we can’t make it on your behalf! However, we can support you during the process by informing you of current market conditions, best practices for getting your business ready for sale, advice on pricing and how to structure your business sale transaction, and much more. Our team would be pleased to answer any questions you might have. We would love to hear from you! Transaction Advisory & Process Support The decision to pursue a sale, recapitalization, or strategic transition is one of the most consequential decisions a business owner will make. While the decision itself is yours, the execution should be deliberate, informed, and professionally managed. We serve as your M&A advisor throughout the lifecycle of the transaction — providing objective guidance, disciplined process management, and market intelligence at every stage. Market Intelligence & Timing Strategy Understanding current market conditions is critical to valuation and deal structure. We provide: Real-time insight into buyer appetite across industries Analysis of active capital in the lower and middle market Valuation multiples based on transaction comparables Assessment of financing markets (SBA, conventional, private credit) Guidance on optimal timing relative to performance cycles This ensures your decision is grounded in current capital market dynamics — not outdated assumptions. Pre-Transaction Preparation & Exit Readiness Value is created before a business goes to market. We help owners prepare through: Financial normalization (SDE / EBITDA adjustments) Quality of earnings positioning Risk mitigation and key dependency analysis Revenue concentration assessment Operational stabilization strategies Working capital preparation Documentation and reporting readiness Proper preparation strengthens buyer confidence, reduces retrading risk, and supports premium valuation. title: Aligning Value, Legacy, and Outcome: The Sale of Advanced Process Solutions
description: Advanced Process Solutions, founded in 2000 by Phillip and Kris, spent more than two decades supporting the semiconductor industry through innovative chemical delivery systems. Their equipment, which transported chemicals from drums into fabrication plants, quietly powered some of the world’s most advanced chip manufacturing operations. What began as a one-person operation quickly became a trusted manufacturing company. By 2003, the team had incorporated and grown to four employees, eventually expanding to more than 30 as demand increased. Over the years, APS has endured global challenges, including 9/11 and the 2008 financial crisis, but resilience and dedication have allowed the company to emerge stronger each time. By 2020, APS was thriving once again, experiencing consistent revenue growth even through the pandemic. Yet despite their success, the founders realized they had no clear plan for retirement. With a solid reputation and an established team in place, they decided it was the right time to consider selling; not only to secure their own future but also to ensure the long-term well-being of their employees.

title: SEARCH PROPERTIES & APPLY ONLINE
description: RIVERWEST Riverwest has long been known as an artist community. Due to its proximity to the East Side and UW-Milwaukee campus, Riverwest attracts a number of young people, students and families. VIEW AVAILABILITY SHOREWOOD Nestled between the shores of Lake Michigan and the banks of the Milwaukee River, the Village of Shorewood has all the charm, the green space and the walkability of small-town living at its best. Yet its location, just a few minutes drive from downtown Milwaukee, gives its residents and visitors countless opportunities to enjoy the many cultural, retail and business opportunities offered in a major metropolitan area. AVAILABILITY BAY VIEW Bay View became the first suburb of Milwaukee when it incorporated as a village in 1879. The village was then annexed in 1887 making Bay View a part of the city of Milwaukee for over a century. With it’s quaint neighborhoods, interesting architecture, friendly people and a local business district, this South Shore Community still has the feel of a small village. It’s probably why this Milwaukee neighborhood continues to be referred to as Bay View. Button EAST SIDE & UWM The East Side is a neighborhood of Milwaukee, Wisconsin, considered to be a cultural and trend-setting center of the city since at least the 1960s. Encompassing an area just north of downtown Milwaukee to Shorewood, bordered by the Milwaukee River and Lake Michigan, the area encompasses residences, bars, shops, art theaters, live music clubs and the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee campus AVAILABILITY BRADY STREET Nine blocks running east to west from Lake Michigan to the Milwaukee River that contain some of the city’s finest restaurants, shops, taverns, lounges, salons and cafes. From every day necessities to the extraordinary you’ll find it here, in a neighborhood where the emphasis is on community, with locally owned and operated establishments each with its own unique flavor. AVAILABILITY

description: Buy/Sell a Car Wash – I am a Seller Home »  Buy/Sell a Car Wash – I am a Seller Car Wash Owner: Have you ever thought about this? Did you know only 18% of all small businesses that are available for sale, actually sell. What happens to the rest of them (82%) and why? To most small business owners the eventual sale of their business represents the means for them to realize their retirement dreams. The big problem is that most car wash owners are not experienced in the process of planning, pricing and marketing their business in order to realize the maximum value for it, and all too often, this can result in their business ending up in the 82% group referred to above that never sell. If you are considering selling your gas station or car wash business, now is the time to begin the planning process, positioning yourself and your business to maximize the value of your business when it is eventually sold. CWB can help you to understand some of the issues that can arise when a business is being sold that can either prevent a sale from happening or cause a deal to fall apart. Our experience in accumulating all relevant information needed for buyers review, lenders muster and ultimately, appraisers is now available. These documents can now be professionally prepared in our “Car Wash Package”. Details on preparing these packages can be obtained by contacting our offices. I am Roger Pencek (MBA) founder and broker for CWB, Inc.  and have been personally selling car washes and gas stations since 1985. I am committed to my clients by utilizing the highest standards of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality which these packages command. References and list of recent sales are available upon written request. If you have any questions regarding the enclosed information or if you would like to further explore the process of selling your business, please feel free to contact me. description: Quota licenses are considered property in Florida, and can be purchased and transferred for reasonable consideration. Restrictions that apply to other types of licenses, such as minimum square footage, seating, and food sales, do not apply to quota licenses. Because of this, these licenses are highly desirable for nightclubs, bars, and other businesses where the main focus is the sale of liquor for consumption. If you’re looking to purchase a license or you recently acquired one, complying with the requirements for license transfers can be a long process. From closing to the time you get the permanent license in the name of your business, we can assist with this process

description: About our foundation A world where every autistic person is empowered to reach their full potential Our mission Through advocacy, education, and direct support, we work to break down barriers and foster a community of true inclusion and understanding for every individual on the autism spectrum. Our vision To be a leading catalyst for life-enhancing research and accessible resources — ensuring neurodiversity is celebrated and families have the tools they need to thrive at every stage of life. What we do We offer programs that assist individuals with autism spectrum disorder and their families, focused on early intervention, support services, education, advocacy, and community integration. Family support & resources A clear navigation path from early diagnosis guidance to transition-to-adulthood planning, backed by peer-led support groups. You are not alone. Early intervention: ABA, speech & language, occupational therapy Music and equestrian therapy referrals Teen chats, videos, and independence planning Advocacy & awareness Neuro-inclusion is about understanding and adapting to the ways different people experience the world. We partner with policymakers, educators, and employers to protect the rights of autistic people. Autism-friendly workplace accreditation Reasonable accommodations and sensory break rooms School and public-space inclusion reviews Community programs From sensory-friendly events to vocational workshops, our programs build confidence, friendship, and real opportunity. Monthly sensory-friendly market Annual Walk or Jump with Matiti Biweekly Mom & Pop roundtables Our core values Inclusion We believe in a society where everyone belongs — at school, at work, and in public life. Empowerment We focus on strengths, not challenges, and build on what each person already does well. Integrity We are committed to transparency and to evidence-based practices in every program we run. NH Real Estate Licensing Obtaining a real estate license in New Hampshire: ​ The basic steps to get your NH real estate salesperson license and become a real estate agent are: ​ Be at least 18 years old and have a social security number. Take the 40 hour New Hampshire real estate course. Register to take the NH real estate test using your course completion certificate. Pass the New Hampshire real estate test. Affiliate with a NH Real Estate Brokerage. Send your application to the New Hampshire Real Estate Commission . With your application, you should also include the original exam score you received as well as the licensing fee. LEARN MORE MA Real Estate Licensing Obtaining a real estate license in Massachusetts: ​ The basic steps to get your MA real estate salesperson license and become a real estate agent are: ​ Be at least 18 years old and have a social security number. Take the 40 hour Massachusetts real estate course. CE SHOP Pre-Licensing . Get a background check (CORI) - Determination of Good Moral Character Compliance for Initial Broker or Salesperson. Register to take the Massachusetts real estate test using your course completion certificate. Pass the Massachusetts real estate test. The national portion of the exam consists of 80 questions to be answered within 150 minutes. The state portion consists of 40 questions to be answered within 90 minutes. To pass, you will need a score of at least 70%. Pay the license fee and receive your license. title: What to Do When Your Business Partner Doesn’t Want to Sell
description: Home Mergers & Acquisitions Don Dillon Mergers & Acquisitions , Selling a Business , Uncategorized What to Do When Your Business Partner Doesn’t Want to Sell Deciding to exit your business is a major life milestone, but it becomes exponentially more complex when you aren’t the sole decision-maker. At BrokersBiz , we often see situations where one partner is ready for retirement or a new venture, while the other is still focused on growth. When interests are no longer aligned, it can stall the company’s progress and even reduce its overall market value. If you are ready to move on but your partner isn’t, here is how you can navigate the path forward while protecting the business you built together. 1. Review Your Legal Agreements Before tensions rise, look at your foundational documents. Your Operating Agreement or Shareholders’ Agreement often contains “Buy-Sell” provisions. These clauses are designed specifically for this moment, outlining how a partner can be bought out or how the business should be valued in the event of a disagreement. 2. Perform a Professional Valuation Often, a partner’s hesitation to sell stems from a fear of the unknown or a disagreement on what the business is actually worth. Don Dillon , a Licensed Real Estate Instructor with over 28 years of experience, provides comprehensive valuations that move beyond simple math. Having a verified, professional figure for the company’s “true market potential” can often bridge the gap between partners and provide a realistic starting point for negotiations. 3. Explore Internal Buyout Options If your partner wants to keep the business running, an internal buyout might be the smoothest transition. In this scenario, your partner (or the company itself) purchases your shares. At BrokersBiz , we help provide the legal coordination and financial discovery necessary to ensure you receive a fair payout while the business remains stable under the remaining partner’s leadership. 4. title: Your Omaha Business Brokers.
description: Who We Are As an entrepreneur, you know full well that owning a business is an exciting adventure. You also have enough foresight to know the time may come when you decide to sell that business, or perhaps buy a new one. When such situations arise, it’s to your advantage to work with a team of professionals who will provide you with honest—and fair—market valuations…and that’s when you’ll be best served by Business Evaluations and Successful Transitions (BEST Advisors). Our team is dedicated to providing business owners like yourself with the information you need to make clear, reasoned decisions. We consider the many factors you’ll require to fully understand the potentials and limitations of any business under study. If you’re SELLING, we make sure that you have a realistic view of the worth of your business. Our team provides an accurate, honest, and fair market valuation that will help you get the best possible price for your concern. We also realize that considerable emotions come into play when going through a sale, and we’re here to support you in any way we can during the transition. If you’re BUYING a business, it’s essential for you to know the finances and culture of that enterprise. Our experienced team stands ready to provide you with detailed financial analyses, which will help you to understand the company’s culture and make sure it aligns with your goals and values. Our team has an extensive track record in the way small businesses operate, with an understanding of diverse mechanisms like technology, human capital management, manufacturing, insurance, construction and more. We introduce qualified buyers to motivated business owners and establish a relationship that will ultimately lead to a satisfactory ownership transition, for both parties. At BEST Advisors, we’re committed to providing the best possible service to our clients. title: NAVIGATING T&H’S RENTAL LISTINGS
description: NAVIGATING T&H’S RENTAL LISTINGS When searching for available homes for rent on our website, you may notice that there are several different buttons to choose from on each property listing. We realize this can be somewhat confusing and you may not know which option to choose. Below we will explain each option and what you need to do to successfully view or apply for a home. Description: This button will open up a dropdown with all of the property details and photos. Here you can see all of the information about the home that you would need to know.
